Junior Product Designer
Anvil Studio | Remote (India)

We are a ten-person product studio. You will work directly with clients on
end-to-end product design, from research through shipped interface.

Responsibilities
- Conduct user research and usability testing
- Produce wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity interface designs
- Contribute to and maintain design systems
- Present and defend design decisions to clients
- Work closely with engineers during implementation

Must have
- A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work
- Proficiency in Figma
- Understanding of interaction design and information architecture
- Ability to explain the reasoning behind design decisions
- Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG

Bonus
- Motion design skills
- Ability to write HTML and CSS
- Experience designing for complex data-heavy interfaces
- Prior agency or studio experience

Portfolio required. Applications without one will not be reviewed.
